title: Vibeprint: how does an iPad sketch reach the local coding agent?
scope: The sketch path from iPad canvas through the local daemon, its state files and interpreter, to the agent's MCP tools.
omissions: Quick code-map generation via spawned CLI

notes.title: Daemon-down fallback
notes.text: Without the daemon, MCP reads/writes .vibeprint/ directly; live waiting is unavailable.

notes.title: Relay is optional
notes.text: Relay off when unset; if unreachable, daemon prints LAN URL and keeps retrying in background.

notes.title: Canvas fails closed
notes.text: Unparseable canvas.json throws, asking to resolve merge conflicts or restore from git.
